name: Name
forbidden: You do not have permission to view the event catalog.
read_only: This event contract is managed by its source and is read-only here.
save_error: The event could not be saved. Check the selected interface and phase, then retry.
catalog_error: The event catalog could not be loaded. Retry with Refresh.
runtime_error: The runtime snapshot could not be loaded. Retry with Refresh.
ephemeral: Current host instance observations only. Activity and observation metadata are temporary; original sources retain their own delivery and persistence policies.
consumed_help: Consumed means a delivery was dequeued and handed to its consumer. It does not indicate workflow success or failure. Viewing this page does not consume events.
queue_counters_help: Events are broadcast across subscriptions. Each subscription has its own queue; consumers compete within that queue. Counters cover the current subscription membership lifetime, independently of the activity window, and must not be added to window totals.
workflow_reason_unavailable: The subscription cannot currently accept new events. Check its application configuration and permissions.
workflow_refresh_error: Workflow subscriptions could not be refreshed. Retry with Refresh.
reason_event_unavailable: The event is missing or disabled.
reason_phase_unavailable: The selected trigger phase is unavailable.
reason_input_mapping: The workflow input mapping is invalid.
reason_application_unpublished: The application has no available publication.
reason_compiled_plan: The published execution plan is unavailable.
reason_trigger_type: The application is not an event workflow.
reason_workspace_unavailable: Workspace access is unavailable or has changed.
reason_runtime_unconfigured: No runtime resource policy is configured.
reason_resource_exhausted: The runtime resource budget is insufficient.
reason_receiver_failed: The event receiver stopped after an error.
reason_refresh_unavailable: The subscription configuration could not be refreshed.
reason_snapshot_changed: Subscription configuration changed; existing deliveries are draining.
reason_not_authenticated: Authentication is required to activate the subscription.
reason_component_export: A required component export is invalid.
reason_state_transition: The current state prevents subscription activation.
results_help: Leave empty to include completed, failed, rejected and cancelled invocations.
interface_help: Choose an API and phase from the complete API catalog. Event fields inherit the API parameter or response contract; configure workflow input mapping in the application event trigger.
no_interfaces: No APIs are available for discovery.
select_interface_phase: Choose an API and phase to view the inherited event schema.
legacy_rule: This existing rule keeps its original interface binding and payload schema.
api_catalog_error: The API catalog or details could not be loaded. Refresh to retry.
api_reason_missing_openapi_contract: This API has no usable documentation contract.
api_reason_missing_binding: This API is not bound to the invocation kernel.
api_reason_missing_typed_codec: This API has no event data projection.
api_reason_no_workspace_principal: This API has no workspace identity for publishing events.
api_reason_permission_denied: You do not have permission to access this API.
api_reason_target_unavailable: The API target is currently unavailable.
api_reason_binary_request: This phase accepts binary content without an event parameter contract.
api_reason_binary_response: This phase returns binary content without an event result contract.
api_reason_missing_streaming_terminal: This API has no declared stream completion result contract.
api_reason_credential_boundary: This phase contains credentials and cannot publish a regular event.
api_reason_ambiguous_operation: This API matches multiple targets and cannot be bound uniquely.
api_reason_operational_control: This operational endpoint does not produce business invocation events.
api_reason_protocol_control: This protocol control endpoint does not produce business invocation events.
runtime_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the identifier and copy it manually.
runtime_record_unavailable: This record is not in the latest snapshot. Close the details and locate it again if it is still retained.
runtime_no_subscribed_events: No identifiable event-center subscriptions were observed in this snapshot; this does not prove that no event rules are configured.
runtime_unclassified_status_help: Subscription status lacks an event identity on this host, so it cannot reliably be assigned to an event.
runtime_event_subscriptions_help: An event can fan out to independent subscriptions. This is a snapshot; dequeuing a delivery does not mean a workflow ran successfully.
runtime_center_queue_only: Event-center queues only; excludes original business queues
runtime_no_event_subscriptions: No event-center subscriptions were observed for this event.
runtime_unclassified_help: The snapshot does not establish this consumer type
runtime_queue_not_observed: Runtime queue was not observed; backlog cannot be assumed to be zero
runtime_no_matches: No matches in this snapshot. Clear the filters to see all fetched records.
runtime_find_activity: Find event or identifier in this snapshot
runtime_snapshot_filter: Filters apply only to this fetched snapshot, not to persistent event history.
runtime_no_activity: No activity is retained in this scope and observation window.
runtime_waiting_for_network: Waiting for a connection; updates will resume automatically
runtime_forbidden: You do not have permission to view this runtime snapshot.
runtime_retained_snapshot: Refresh failed. Showing the previous snapshot from {{time}}; it is not current data.
runtime_stale_snapshot: This snapshot is older than the activity window. Refresh before judging current conditions.
runtime_scope_unavailable: The requested scope is not available in this snapshot. Choose an available scope.
runtime_records_limited: Some activity records were evicted for space or dropped because they were oversized. See the report above.
stats_trend_hint: Samples actual queued delivery counts during this visit, retaining up to 30 minutes. Sampling restarts when the page is reopened.
stats_queue_count_hint: Observed event-center runtime queues in the visible scopes. Excludes subscription configurations without a runtime queue and queues owned by original business modules.
stats_buffered_hint: Deliveries not yet dequeued. Another {{in_flight}} deliveries have been received and still hold resources. Current queues have accepted {{accepted}} deliveries and rejected {{rejected}} admissions over their lifetimes.
stats_consumer_count_hint: Consumers registered with the current queues. Multiple consumers may compete for one subscription. This is not a workflow execution count.
stats_consumed_hint: Successful dequeues over the lifetimes of queues that still exist. This does not indicate workflow success. Retired queues are no longer included.
observation_stats_trend_hint: Samples real snapshots while Recent activity is open, retaining up to 30 minutes. Sampling restarts when the view is reopened.
observation_stats_budget_hint: Charged size of activity records, accounting and source metadata in the visible scopes. The shared host limit is {{max}}. This is not queue payload size or process memory.
observation_stats_retention_hint: Currently retained activity records. Records are retained for {{minutes}} minutes.
observation_stats_known_counts: Records removed after reaching their retention age, across reporting scopes. Scopes without statistics are not counted as zero.
observation_stats_evicted_hint: Records removed early to make room for new records, across reporting scopes.
observation_stats_oversize_hint: Records not retained because a single record exceeded available space, across reporting scopes.
observation_stats_rejected_hint: Delivery rejections recorded within the current workspace retention window. These are not workflow execution failures.
